verdict.rationale: The firm's single combined IP page says its patent work runs "from strategy and filing to licensing and disputes" and its trademark work extends to "enforcement," so IP contentious work is claimed. Nothing in the evidence describes specific courts, venues, case outcomes or trade-secret litigation. missing for 10: named courts or venues for IP litigation, described case outcomes or representative matters, trade-secret dispute coverage, independent corroboration of the IP litigation track record.
